text: S612 did not execute the planned Standard-DXF input-mode trial: active CUA reports no apps, and its documented listWindows/getApp methods are unavailable. No CLO window was freshly bound and no file or project was touched. This is a computer-use access blocker, not a CLO format failure; all V03 criteria and holds remain. Next restore a supported native-window binding without restarting CLO, or proceed on independent source-backed evidence. See E-G04-S612-EXIT.
